snippet.title: Hunter's Trophy 2 Australia Xbox 360 Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hunter's Trophy 2 - Australia Gameplay Trailer Xbox 360

Experience all the excitement of the hunt in Australia!

From buffalo to dingo, track 25 different preys in this hunting simulation set in the most beautiful countryside in Australia. Complete 30 hunting plans, play as your hunting dog during tracking phases and take on a friend in Ball-Trap mode!

More complete, fun and realistic than ever, the Hunting Challenge series has earned a reputation as the best hunting simulation for consoles. Realistic animal behaviour, a variety of environments, weapons, animals, hunting plans, equipment and skills to unlock, online leaderboards, training in shooting at fixed and moving targets... all are brought together to offer a unique gaming experience which will delight experienced and novice hunters as well as players just looking to experience something new.

The game is now set in australian landscapes, in download on PC and Xbox Live Arcade (XBLA) (and on PSN very soon).

RELEASE DATE: May 29, 2013
DEVELOPER: Kylotonn Entertainment
PUBLISHER: Bigben Interactive
GENRE: Hunting Simulation/Shooter
PLATFORMS: PC, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360
WEBSITE: http://www.bigben-interactive.co.uk/produit/game/id/7159
ACHIEVEMENTS: http://vgfaq.com/achievements/hunters-trophy-2-australia-achievements-guide/
